About Equus Aurum

Your way of travelling.
Our starting point.

We are a travel agency with personalized service. We start from what you are looking for to organize transport, accommodation and itinerary options, respecting your priorities and your budget.

A family trip, a getaway for two or the discovery of a new destination: planning begins with a conversation about what makes sense for you.

What we do

From planning to your next trip.

01

Airfare

Search, quotes and ticketing for domestic and international flights, based on your destination and dates.

02

Miles management

Guidance to organize your miles and evaluate how to use them when planning trips.

03

Accommodation and travel services

Hotel selection matched to the type of trip, plus travel insurance, tours, car rental and transfers.

04

Tailored itineraries

Organization of destinations, activities and recommendations for each stage of the trip, with attention to your preferences.
